sources.title: A nonparametric model-based estimator for the cumulative distribution function of a right censored variable in a finite population
sources.snippet: In survey analysis, the estimation of the cumulative distribution function (cdf) is of great interest: it allows for instance to derive quantiles estimators or other non linear parameters derived from the cdf. We consider the case where the response variable is a right censored duration variable. In this framework, the classical estimator of the cdf is the Kaplan-Meier estimator.
